description:
The Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhawak Pension Scheme was launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh on 1st April 2021. 

This scheme is designed to provide financial assistance to the guardians of orphaned girls. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to ensure the welfare and upliftment of orphaned girls in the state. 

The government aims to provide a monthly pension to the guardians to support the upbringing of these girls. 

The scheme targets the guardians of girls who have lost both parents. 

Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,000 is provided to the guardians. 

This financial assistance is intended to alleviate the economic burden on guardians raising orphaned girls. 

The pension is aimed at ensuring that these girls receive proper care and education. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specific and well-defined. 

Guardians must be residents of Madhya Pradesh to qualify for the pension. 

The girls must be below the age of 18 years at the time of application. 

There are no income criteria specified for the guardians to qualify for this scheme. 

The application process for the Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhawak Pension Scheme is straightforward. 

Interested guardians must fill out the application form available at the local government offices. 

They can also apply online through the official Madhya Pradesh government website. 

The required documents include the death certificates of the parents. 

Guardians must also provide proof of their relationship to the girl. 

Identity proof of the guardian is also necessary for the application. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The pension amount will be disbursed directly to the bank account of the guardian. 

The disbursement of the pension is done on a monthly basis. 

The government has set a timeline for the processing of applications. 

Applications are generally processed within 30 days of submission. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Women and Child Development in Madhya Pradesh. 

This department is responsible for overseeing the welfare of women and children in the state. 

For any inquiries or assistance, guardians can contact the department at their local offices. 

The contact details for the Department of Women and Child Development can be found on the official Madhya Pradesh government website. 

This scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Madhya Pradesh government to support vulnerable groups. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crore for the implementation of this scheme. 

The Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhawak Pension Scheme reflects the government's commitment to social welfare. 

It aims to empower orphaned girls and ensure their rights to a secure upbringing. 

The scheme is expected to benefit thousands of orphaned girls across the state. 

As of October 2023, the scheme has already reached over 50,000 beneficiaries. 

The government regularly reviews the scheme to ensure its effectiveness and reach. 

Feedback is collected from beneficiaries to improve the implementation process. 

The Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhawak Pension Scheme is a significant step towards gender equality. 

It recognizes the challenges faced by orphaned girls and their guardians. 

By providing financial support, the scheme aims to reduce the risk of exploitation and neglect. 

The government also promotes awareness about the scheme through various outreach programs. 

These programs aim to educate potential beneficiaries about the application process and benefits. 

The scheme is aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals set by the United Nations. 

It specifically targets goals related to gender equality and reduced inequalities. 

The Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhawak Pension Scheme is a vital part of Madhya Pradesh's welfare initiatives. 

It complements other schemes aimed at the empowerment of women and children in the state. 

The government continues to explore additional measures to enhance the welfare of orphaned girls. 

This includes educational scholarships and vocational training programs. 

The Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhawak Pension Scheme is a lifeline for many guardians. 

It provides them with the necessary financial support to care for orphaned girls. 

The scheme's implementation has received positive feedback from various stakeholders. 

NGOs and civil society organizations have praised the government's efforts. 

They emphasize the importance of such schemes in promoting social justice. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's focus on inclusive development. 

It aims to create a supportive environment for orphaned girls to thrive. 

The Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhawak Pension Scheme is an essential initiative. 

It addresses the specific needs of orphaned girls and their guardians. 

The government remains committed to ensuring the success of this scheme. 

Regular monitoring and evaluation are conducted to assess its impact. 

This ensures that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries effectively. 

The Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhawak Pension Scheme is a crucial part of Madhya Pradesh's social welfare landscape. 

It highlights the government's dedication to protecting the rights of vulnerable populations. 

The scheme is expected to evolve with changing needs and circumstances. 

The government is open to making necessary adjustments based on feedback. 

This approach ensures that the scheme remains relevant and effective. 

The Mukhyamantri Kanya Abhibhawak Pension Scheme stands as a model for similar initiatives across India. 

It showcases the importance of targeted welfare programs in addressing specific social issues. 

The scheme is a beacon of hope for many orphaned girls and their guardians in Madhya Pradesh. 

It reinforces the belief that every child deserves a chance at a better future.
